bounding-box-viewer.config.title: Bounding Box Viewer
bounding-box-viewer.config.keys_info: %s turns the boxes on and off (singleplayer worlds only). Keys are under Options > Controls > Key Binds > Bounding Box Viewer, including one (unbound at first) that switches drawing through blocks.
bounding-box-viewer.config.range.tooltip:
How many blocks out from you, across the ground,
a structure's box can be and still show, at any height.
Structures show once the game has loaded them,
so the farthest are about your render distance away.
bounding-box-viewer.config.see_through.t:
Yes: boxes are drawn on top of everything, so you see
strongholds, mineshafts and fortresses inside the ground.
No: blocks hide boxes like anything else in the world.
bounding-box-viewer.config.show_pieces.t:
Thinner boxes for each piece of a structure (fortress
corridors, village houses and roads, mineshaft tunnels)
inside the box around the whole structure.
bounding-box-viewer.config.shade_spawn_a:
Shades where a structure's own mobs spawn:
witches in a swamp hut, pillagers anywhere in an
outpost's box, guardians in a monument's, blazes and
wither skeletons in a fortress's pieces.
bounding-box-viewer.config.show_labels.t: The structure's name over the top of its box.
